title: The Culture Within: Towards Mechanistic Understanding of Cultural Reasoning in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model alignment with documented cultural norms using the CultureLens benchmark, which tests behavioral scenarios under varying prompt conditions (e.g., true norms, contradictory norms, specific values) and uses mechanistic interpretability techniques like linear probes, attention knockout, and norm erasure to track cultural reasoning.

Comparing model performance and internal representations across 75 different countries, specifically measuring an 'Anglophone gap' where unprompted model defaults heavily favor the cultural norms of the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand over other nations.
